response.original_title: Aja Monet Live At The Blue Note, NYC
response.overview: Set during her sold-out residency at the historic Blue Note Jazz Club, this intimate short film follows Grammy-nominated poet Aja Monet as she moves between performance and stillness, transforming the stage into a space for vulnerability, resistance, and connection. Captured entirely on film, the piece observes the quiet moments behind the voice as much as the electricity of the room itself, creating an immersive reflection on resence, artistry, and what it means truly be heard.
response.tagline: A film shot portrait of Grammy nominated poet Aja Monet during her sold out residency at the historic Blue Note, capturing the energy, intimacy, and power of her voice in its purest form.
response.title: Aja Monet Live At The Blue Note, NYC
